events.name: Bash
events.head: Capture probe-details output
events.input: $ timeout 300 node app/scripts/probe-details.mjs - - > /tmp/t240-pd.txt 2>&1; echo exit=$?; wc -l /tmp/t240-pd.txt; tail -15 /tmp/t240-pd.txt; sed -n 1,30p app/scripts/probe-details.mjs | grep -n "usage\|argv"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-details static mode
events.input: $ node app/scripts/probe-details.mjs - - > /tmp/t240-pd.txt 2>&1; echo exit=$?; wc -l /tmp/t240-pd.txt; grep -E "FAIL" /tmp/t240-pd.txt | head; tail -6 /tmp/t240-pd.txt

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect output and screenshot-fill check
events.input: $ cat /tmp/t240-pd.txt | cut -c1-200 | head -22; grep -n "screenshot\|fill" app/scripts/probe-details.mjs | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe-details header and page loop
events.input: $ sed -n 1,40p app/scripts/probe-details.mjs | cut -c1-220; sed -n 255,300p app/scripts/probe-details.mjs | cut -c1-220

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check local mirror server and export
events.input: $ curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4361/tantra-workshop-live/ ; lsof -iTCP:4361 -sTCP:LISTEN | tail -2; ls app/out 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls -la app/out/index.html 2>/dev/null; grep -n "4361" -r app/scripts/*.sh app/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -5

events.text: Static probe shows 0 screenshot FAILs, but that check only runs against a served export. Checking the 3 images' dimensions vs siblings next.

events.name: Bash
events.head: List image dimensions for the three shots and siblings
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/public && find . -name "audience-room*" | head; for d in $(find . -type d -name "s1-cold-email" -o -type d -name "s4-rsp"); do echo "== $d"; for f in $d/*.webp; do printf "%s " $(basename $f); sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight $f | awk '/pixel/{printf $2" "}'; echo; done; done 2>&1 | head -60
